thread:
maria: FYI I just got the scanner alert for several distro base images. needs quick triage, looks like glibc and a small OpenSSL backport hit our images.
owen: can you paste the CVEs and which tags are affected?
maria: sure — scanner output below:
```
CVE-2026-2101 - glibc: dynamic loader issue
CVE-2026-2148 - openssl: padding oracle variant
CVE-2026-2200 - zlib: inflate boundary
Affected images: redwood/base:ubuntu-22.04, redwood/base:alpine-3.18, redwood/runtime:ubuntu-22.04-py3.10
```
anna: ok. priority: glibc > openssl > zlib for us because glibc can break libc-bound containers and static-linked bins.
owen: any chance we can patch instead of full rebuild for ubuntu? backport packages or do we need to rebuild images to pull new libc into layer?
maria: Ubuntu has LTS security backports; we can apt-get upgrade libc6 in image and update tag but for Alpine we need new musl/glibc packages -> full image rebuild safer.
sec-bot: Scan findings: https://scans.internal/redwood/17698 — current CVSS aggregated 7.8, exploit maturity medium
anna: plan proposal:
- today: triage + determine minimal fixes per image (owen)
- tomorrow AM: build candidate images with patched pkgs and run unit tests in staging (maria)
- tomorrow afternoon: deploy canary to canary cluster (5% traffic) and monitor latency / crashes for 4h (anna)
- rollback policy: if any OOMs/crashes, automatic rollback to previous tag
- sign rebuilt images with KMS key rotation token `kms://img-signer/v2` before pushing to prod
owen: tagging convention suggestion: `redwood/base:2026-03-31-glibc-patched` and keep old tags immutable.
maria: will add a small smoke test for statically linked binaries and Python native modules — glibc changes are risky.
anna: also add an audit-log entry for the rollout (RBAC: only infra-release group can trigger canary-to-prod). cc @sec-bot to log.
sec-bot: Logged event: image-rebuild-1769801234 by maria, policy: infra-release-only. Audits available at /audit/1769801234
owen: do we need to notify customers or is this security-maint callback internal-only?
maria: internal-first. If we need a maintenance window for Dedicated customers we’ll coordinate with CS; otherwise quick patch push with no downtime.
anna: Ok. action owners: owen=builds, maria=smoke tests + push, anna=canary + monitoring dashboard, sec-bot=audit + scan re-run. Target full prod rollout EOD+1 after clean canary.
maria: I'm starting the rebuild now, will post image names when ready. :hammer_and_wrench:
owen: thanks — will queue CI. :thumbsup:
